title: Welsh Index of Multiple Deprivation 2019 index and domain scores
description: WIMD 2019 overall index score and the eight domain scores (income, employment, health, education, access to services, housing, community safety, physical environment) for every Welsh LSOA.

files.note: "WIMD 2019 Index and domain scores by small area", released 27 November 2019 and last updated 1 October 2020. Sheets: Guidance_Sheet, Data, WIMD_2019_LSOA_index_and_domain_scores.

CSV export of the WIMD_2019_LSOA_index_and_domain_scores sheet, read by the loader. Carries the sheet's three-line preamble, so the real header is on line 4 and data starts on line 5: 1,909 LSOAs x 12 columns. Should disappear once the preprocessor reads the .ods directly via the reader's odsContent.
